VAULT_REPO.description: The GitHub repo your Cairn vault syncs to, as `owner/name`.

VAULT_BRANCH.description: Its branch. Cairn syncs to `main` unless you changed it.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: A [fine-grained token](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new) with **Contents: read and write** on the vault repo only.

ACCESS_TEAM_DOMAIN.description: Your Cloudflare Access team domain, such as `myteam.cloudflareaccess.com` (Zero Trust → Settings).

ACCESS_AUD.description: Type `unset` for now, and turn on **Protect with Cloudflare Access** below. After the deploy, copy the **AUD tag** from the Worker's **Access** tab into `wrangler.toml` in your new repo.

ALLOWED_EMAILS.description: Optional: the only emails let in, comma-separated, checked as well as your Access policy. `unset` lets in anyone your policy allows.
